import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset

# Set the style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to show the distribution of sleep duration based on BMI Category
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, ax=ax, palette='pastel')

# Add a title and labels
ax.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to show the distribution of sleep duration based on BMI Category
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, ax=ax, palette='pastel')

# Add a title and labels
ax.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
